questions: Should the pairplot use the default seaborn style (e.g., whitegrid) or should it explicitly set a style (e.g., sns.set_style('whitegrid'))?
Is the figure size (or aspect ratio) of the pairplot specified, or should it use seaborn's default size?
Should the pairplot include any specific plot kinds (e.g., scatter for off-diagonal, hist for diagonal) beyond 'default pairplot behavior'?
Are any pairplot parameters like 'corner', 'hue', 'palette', 'markers', or 'plot_kws' required to be set or left default?
Should the function close the figure or leave it open for further modification after returning?
Is the diabetes dataset's target column (progression) required to be included in the pairplot DataFrame?
Should the function set any specific rcParams besides font family (e.g., font size, weight) for Arial?
Is the pairplot expected to have a title or axis labels modified from default?
